description: Defines the URLRequestContextBuilder class used for constructing and configuring URLRequestContext objects in Chromium's networking code. Contains methods for setting cache parameters, proxy settings, network components, and other network-related configurations.

classes.name: URLRequestContextBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing URLRequestContext objects with configurable network components and parameters.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured URLRequestContext object based on the builder's current settings.

methods.name: set_enable_brotli
methods.description: Enables or disables Brotli compression for requests.

methods.name: set_check_cleartext_permitted
methods.description: Sets whether to permit cleartext HTTP/WS requests based on system policy.

methods.name: set_require_network_isolation_key
methods.description: Sets whether to require network isolation keys.

methods.name: set_network_quality_estimator
methods.description: Assigns a NetworkQualityEstimator to the builder.

methods.name: set_proxy_config_service
methods.description: Sets a custom ProxyConfigService.

methods.name: set_pac_quick_check_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables quick PAC checks.

methods.name: set_proxy_resolution_service
methods.description: Sets a custom ProxyResolutionService.

methods.name: set_ssl_config_service
methods.description: Sets a custom SSLConfigService.

methods.name: set_accept_language
methods.description: Sets the Accept-Language header value for requests.

methods.name: set_user_agent
methods.description: Sets the User-Agent header value for requests.

methods.name: set_http_user_agent_settings
methods.description: Sets a custom HttpUserAgentSettings object.

methods.name: SetProtocolHandler
methods.description: Associates a ProtocolHandler with a URL scheme.

methods.name: set_net_log
methods.description: Assigns a NetLog for logging network events.

methods.name: set_host_resolver
methods.description: Sets a custom HostResolver.

methods.name: set_host_mapping_rules
methods.description: Defines host mapping rules for the resolver.

methods.name: set_host_resolver_manager
methods.description: Uses a shared HostResolverManager.

methods.name: set_host_resolver_factory
methods.description: Sets a custom HostResolver factory.

methods.name: set_network_delegate
methods.description: Sets a custom NetworkDelegate.

methods.name: set_proxy_delegate
methods.description: Sets a custom ProxyDelegate.

methods.name: SetHttpAuthHandlerFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom HttpAuthHandlerFactory.

methods.name: EnableHttpCache
methods.description: Enables HTTP caching with specified parameters.

methods.name: DisableHttpCache
methods.description: Disables HTTP caching.

methods.name: set_http_network_session_params
methods.description: Overrides default HttpNetworkSession parameters.

methods.name: set_transport_security_persister_file_path
methods.description: Sets the file path for transport security persistence.

methods.name: set_hsts_policy_bypass_list
methods.description: Sets a list of HSTS bypass domains.

methods.name: SetSpdyAndQuicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables SPDY and QUIC protocols.

methods.name: set_throttling_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables request throttling.

methods.name: set_ct_policy_enforcer
methods.description: Sets a CTPolicyEnforcer.

methods.name: set_sct_auditing_delegate
methods.description: Sets an SCTAuditingDelegate.

methods.name: set_quic_context
methods.description: Sets a QuicContext.

methods.name: SetCertVerifier
methods.description: Sets a custom CertVerifier.

methods.name: set_reporting_service
methods.description: Sets a reporting service (conditional on build flags).

methods.name: set_reporting_policy
methods.description: Sets a reporting policy (conditional on build flags).

methods.name: set_network_error_logging_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables network error logging.

methods.name: SetNetworkErrorLoggingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom NetworkErrorLoggingService for testing.

methods.name: set_persistent_reporting_and_nel_store
methods.description: Sets persistent reporting and NEL store (conditional on build flags).

methods.name: SetCookieStore
methods.description: Overrides the cookie store.

methods.name: SetHttpServerProperties
methods.description: Overrides HTTP server properties.

methods.name: SetCreateHttpTransactionFactoryCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to create HttpTransactionFactory.

methods.name: set_client_socket_factory_for_testing
methods.description: Sets a mock ClientSocketFactory for testing.

methods.name: set_client_socket_factory
methods.description: Sets a ClientSocketFactory.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the context to a specific network handle.
